deposit: Mobile Money (MTN / Airtel) and Crypto USDT TRC20 are both accepted.
A deposit stays pending until admin confirms the payment.
When confirmed the same amount is credited to the member wallet.
Confirmed deposits are written on the company pool ledger.
Company MoMo number and crypto wallet stay in the background.
credit: Member wallets are credited from confirmed deposits.
Withdrawals take 10% service charge and are paid from the member wallet.
Member files are merged on every boot so existing logins stay valid.
